name: CLI
notes: `echoctl` commands not covered by an area above

features.feature: `echoctl --help` and each subcommand's `--help` list the commands; most print JSON
Every command works on the data folder of `ECHOCTL_HOME` / `ECHOCTL_CONFIG_DIR`
`echoctl status` without the app reports no watcher and today's agenda
`project list / show / of / people / found` give threads, their calls with why, a call's threads and suggestions, people, candidates — as the window shows them
`project create / set / rule / include / exclude / reset / delete` change a thread as the window does
`project ledger <id> tree` and `edit` (edit, ac_set, link, merge, delete, accept, reject, undo, create) read and change the work as the user
`project tasks` sorts open tasks into the piles and asks by person
`context`, `actions`, `action`, `title`, `type`, `note`, `html`, `delete`, `restore` work on one call by folder name or path
`read <echo://…>` gives the text behind a call (around a moment), thread, client, person, task or prep link, read only
`series list / set`, `client` and `org` commands, `config` show and change what the window shows
